description: Create the Chart of Accounts management page at /admin/chart-of-accounts/ and add its link in the Sidebar after 'اسناد حسابداری'. Also add a rename-accounts script/utility for one-time Persian renaming of English account names.
steps: Create frontend/src/app/admin/chart-of-accounts/page.tsx with: (a) List all accounts from Odoo using getAccounts() - display code, name, account_type. (b) Add new account form (name, code, account_type dropdown with options: expense, expense_direct_cost, income, income_other, equity, asset_current, liability_current). (c) Edit account name inline or via modal. (d) Delete (deprecate) account button calling deleteAccount(id). (e) RTL Persian UI matching existing page patterns.
In frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx, add { href: '/admin/chart-of-accounts', label: 'سرفصل حساب‌ها', icon: '🗂️' } after the 'اسناد حسابداری' entry (index 6, insert at index 7)

Create frontend/src/app/admin/chart-of-accounts/rename-accounts.ts (or include as a button/function in the page) that renames accounts: 400000->فروش کالا, 500000->بهای تمام شده کالای فروش رفته, 600000->هزینه‌ها, 611000->خرید تجهیزات, 612000->اجاره, 620000->کارمزد بانکی, 630000->حقوق و دستمزد, 301000->سرمایه, 302000->سود تقسیمی شرکا. Use searchRead to find each account by code, then updateAccount to rename it. Expose this as a button on the chart-of-accounts page labeled 'تغییر نام حساب‌ها به فارسی'.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/app/admin/chart-of-accounts/page.tsx exists and renders a full CRUD page for accounts
The Sidebar shows 'سرفصل حساب‌ها' link with icon '🗂️' after 'اسناد حسابداری'
The page has a button to rename English accounts to Persian (the 9 specified mappings)
Users can add, edit name, and deprecate accounts from the page
`npm run build` passes with no TypeScript errors
findings: Build passes cleanly. The write import from odoo-api.ts is unused in the page (searchRead and updateAccount handle all rename logic), but TypeScript tree-shaking handles it. The page renders as a static route.
